item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President issues an effective-date and amendment framework for the proclamation, but this fragment does not itself specify a substantive legal consequence; the operative consequences appear in the separate amendments.","evidence":"effective the date of this proclamation"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently amends the governing proclamation to permit licensed Canadian pipeline imports to be entered through a specified deadline, directly changing when entry is allowed.","evidence":"Entries for consumption of imports from Canada by pipeline may be made until midnight, May 15"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The President requires future agency regulations to impose specified processing and exchange restrictions on licensees; the binding consequence occurs through those regulations.","evidence":"such regulations shall require that imported crude oil and unfinished oils be processed in the licensee's refinery or petrochemical plant"},{"segment_id":"4","code":2,"rationale":"The President amends the cited provision to incorporate the following requirement that the Administrator establish a specified license-fee system by regulation; the consequential result is to be produced through later agency regulation.","evidence":"Subparagraph (1) (i) of paragraph (a) of section 3 is amended to read as follows"},{"segment_id":"5","code":2,"rationale":"The Administrator is mandatorily directed to establish by regulation a fee system for specified import licenses, so the legally consequential fees arise through later agency action.","evidence":"the Administrator shall, by regulation, establish a system of fees for licenses"},{"segment_id":"6","code":2,"rationale":"The President mandates that the Administrator later revoke all affected licenses upon the stated bond event, dictating a specified legally consequential agency outcome.","evidence":"the Administrator shall immediately revoke all licenses issued pursuant to the bond"},{"segment_id":"7","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently imposes a ceiling on allocations and supplies binding product definitions, directly changing the governing allocation and classification rules.","evidence":"Such allocations shall not exceed 75 percent of estimated refinery capacity"},{"segment_id":"8","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently preserves existing commitments and obligations under prior long-term allocations against impairment by the proclamation or implementing regulations.","evidence":"Commitments and obligations contained in long term allocations heretofore made shall be unimpaired"}]}
